description: Convert the standard / standard_2 groups in the source template_definitions modules, in two batches with verification between them. Batch A makes the shared standard_group() helper always emit the table shape (covers 11 call sites incl. standard_2 in a4_a5_related_substances.py) and fixes A4-0004; Batch B edits the 7 inline literals. Then module-layer tests prove formula/criteria preservation and aggregate coverage. Depends on FEAT-001 (sink + harness + _common constants). Independent of FEAT-003 except that FEAT-003 reads the converted modules.
steps: Batch A. In backend-v2/scripts/template_definitions/_common.py change standard_group() (lines ~208-250) so its returned dict is {"key": key, "kind": "table", "label": label, "rows": dict(STANDARD_ROWS), "rowLabel": dict(STANDARD_ROW_LABEL), "fields": fields}; keep the signature and fields unchanged. Update its docstring.

Batch A. In backend-v2/scripts/template_definitions/a4_rs_against_standard_rrf_division.py (~lines 248-254) replace `{**standard_group(...), "renderAsTable": True}` by `standard_group(label="Standard Details", conc_label="Standard Concentration")` (keep the existing arguments) and rewrite the comment above it: the group is now a real one-row table and bare `standard.<field>` references collapse to row 1 in the engine.

Batch A. Change the four flat-mirror assertions from `result.values["standard.conc_ppm"]` to `result.rows["standard"][0]["conc_ppm"]` (same expected numbers): backend-v2/tests/calculation/test_seeded_template_parity.py lines ~141 (TestA1Assay), ~360 (TestA3SaturationSolubility), ~631 (TestA6BDissolutionWithReplacement); backend-v2/tests/calculation/test_a6b_0002_octreotide_parity.py line ~72. Do not touch test_assay_template_e2e.py or test_dissolution_a6a_release.py (inline singleton fixtures).

Batch A verify: `python -m scripts.seed_test_templates --validate-only` exits 0; `python -m pytest tests/calculation -q` has only the known failures; then commit `feat(templates): standard_group emits a tabular standard (helper callers)`.

Batch B. Edit the 7 inline literals in place (kind singleton -> table; add `"rows": dict(STANDARD_ROWS), "rowLabel": dict(STANDARD_ROW_LABEL)`; import the constants from scripts.template_definitions._common; leave `fields` untouched): a1_assay_fp_mgml.py (~63), a2_lyso_content_mgvial.py (~145-148), a2_sodium_chloride_ic_mgvial.py (~149-151), a6_dissolution.py `_a6b_standard_group` (~412-418), a6a_leuprolide_microsphere.py `_standard_group` (~102-105), a6b_octreotide_ph10.py `_standard_group` (~85-88), nitrosamine_routine.py `_standard_group` (~89-93). Do NOT edit a2_lyso_content.py (already converted), the A11 modules, a2_ampho_lipid_content.py, a2_bupivacaine_lipid_ratio.py, or assay.py.

Extend backend-v2/tests/calculation/test_std_details_tabular_rollout.py with the module-layer tests from plan.md item 5: (a) roster test over SEED_TEMPLATES (every `standard`/`standard_2` group is a table with rows {1,10,1} and rowLabel, A4-0004 has no renderAsTable, a2_lyso_content equals the constants, no module group with those keys is a singleton); (b) legacy-vs-new equivalence (empty, synthetic, padded 3 rows) for every module-backed converted template using a test-side revert (kind singleton, drop rows/rowLabel) and the FEAT-001 harness; (c) the `probe` aggregate test (mean/sd/count over 3 standard rows use all rows, generic over every converted group including standard_2 in A4-0001); (d) bounds: 12 stored rows evaluate to 10, 0 stored rows give 1; (e) audit_references clean for every module definition.

Batch B verify: `python -m scripts.seed_test_templates --validate-only` exits 0; `python -m pytest tests/calculation/test_std_details_tabular_rollout.py -q` passes; `python -m pytest -q` (whole suite) fails only the 5 known tests. Commit `feat(templates): tabular standard for inline-literal modules; module-layer rollout tests`.
acceptance_criteria: A grep-free check: a new test asserts that no group keyed `standard` or `standard_2` in SEED_TEMPLATES is a singleton, and that all converted groups have rows == {min:1, max:10, default:1}.

The legacy-vs-new equivalence test passes for all 18 module-backed templates with converted groups plus A2-0002 (identical calculated values, criteria and reportable result in the empty, synthetic and padded variants).
The probe test shows mean, sd and count over a 3-row standard use all 3 rows.
`python -m pytest -q` fails only the 5 known tests.
findings: Committed b8192c2 (Batch A: standard_group() always emits table; A4-0004 spread and renderAsTable removed; 4 flat-mirror assertions now read result.rows['standard'][0]['conc_ppm']) and a95fd85 (Batch B: 7 inline literals converted, imports STANDARD_ROWS/STANDARD_ROW_LABEL; module-layer tests appended to test_std_details_tabular_rollout.py). Not pushed. Verification: seed_test_templates --validate-only exit 0 (both batches); Batch A pytest tests/calculation -q = 949 passed, 5 failed; test_std_details_tabular_rollout.py -q = 131 passed; full pytest -q = 1057 passed, 5 failed = exactly the 5 known. New tests: TestModuleRoster (8), parametrized TestModuleEquivalence x19 converted module templates (reverse-convert equality, audit clean, legacy-vs-new equivalence empty/synth/pad3 with nonblank coverage), parametrized aggregate probe x19 (mean/sd/count use all 3 rows incl. standard_2 in A4-0001), TestStandardGroupHelper (12 rows -> 10, 0 rows -> 1, field keys unchanged). 19 converted module templates = 18 module-backed rollout templates + A2-0002. No deviations. Notes: working-tree files are CRLF, edits preserved CRLF. In this shell, full-suite pytest output is only reliably captured via Start-Process with redirected output/junit file.
